items.statement: 最终：A/B 主要活性差异的综合解释
items.expected: The final answer integrates computed donor preorganization, actual binding geometry and affinity trend to explain the principal A-over-B activity contrast at matched experimental times. A single repeated number or unsupported assertion is insufficient. This item does not require every independent affinity magnitude item to pass or claim proof of the complete catalytic cycle.

items.statement: 最终：全系列解释与单描述符不足
items.expected: The final account explains the different catalyst activity features from both energetic and electronic-structure evidence: combine computed binding free energies, preorganization/conformer accessibility, and framework-dependent electronic effects to explain stronger A/D versus weak B/E and why C prevents a single ESP or affinity descriptor from accounting for all time-dependent observations. Respect C/E time crossings and uncatalyzed background, and do not treat yields as elementary rate constants. No new ML calculation, full catalytic cycle or C–C transition-state study is required.
